nom: medicube PDRN Pink Caffeine Collagen Eye Patche

avis.texte: Wanted to like these but these are so bad. They leave nasty residue so no make can be placed after wearing them. They slide all over your face. The liquid from them drips down. Just so bad.
They're cute, hold on well, and felt good and cooling on my skin. But when I removed them, they left a sticky residue that was hard to remove. In the trash they go.

i've been using them for a little over a month and i can definitely see a difference. I use them in the am in my skin routine and they leave my under eyes bright and not dry at all. I'm definitely buying them again.

avis.titre: Good for what they are for
avis.texte: Love that they weren't stingy with the serum so the patches arent in danger of drying out but for me they are too big for my eyes. My under eyes arent that bad right now so no big noticeable change but will use again when i just didnt get enough sleep

avis.titre: Hate eye patches that slide off
avis.texte: Absolutely despise when I patches are constantly sliding off and these due exactly just that. If you have 20 minutes to constantly be putting them back under your eyes, then great. The benefits are kinda there. I will give them that, but the constant falling off and not being able to just have them on, even while laying down is super annoyin. It Also states you should have them on for about 10 minutes, I'd personally say, from my experience that is false. 10 minutes with these eye patches doesn't do anything, you need At least Thirty to see benefits, and at least more than half of that time is spent constantly putting them back on under my eyes. Honestly hate this product.

I have used these a couple times now and i find fhem to he very saturated with gel. Because of this, the don't stay in place well and they mofe around a lot so I have to keep repositioning them which is annoying. I havent really seen any change to my skin.

avis.titre: Best Eye Patches I have ever used
avis.texte: I tried thse eye patches because of all the hype about Medicube. They are amazing! Hydrating, depuffing ( yes, actually work) and leave the eye area soft and ready for skincare or makeup. They are curved a bit sharp but i switch them, i use the curved end under my wye and thr tail by thr end of my eye. A must try for you !!!!
